title: Local DVRs and orders are unchanged at rational points after field extension
statement: Let $k\subseteq k'$ be an extension of algebraically closed fields [def-sc-field-extension], let $X$ be a smooth proper connected curve over $k$ [def-sc-curves], and let $P$ be a $k$-rational closed point of $X$. Write $X'=X\times_kk'$ [def-pc-base-change] and let $P'$ be the unique point of $X'$ above $P$. Then $\mathcal O_{X,P}$ and $\mathcal O_{X',P'}$ are discrete valuation rings, and for every $f\in k(X)^*$ with pullback $f'\in k(X')^*$ the normalized orders agree: $v_{P'}(f')=v_P(f)$ [def-sc-divisor].

source.place: Affine-case proof, unit quotient paragraph (orders at corresponding boundary points)
source.note: The blueprint invokes this as the standard valuation comparison under extension of algebraically closed fields; the available literature gives no separately named lemma.

proof.text: Choose an affine neighbourhood $U=\operatorname{Spec}A$ of the rational point $P$, with maximal ideal $\mathfrak m$ and residue identification $A/\mathfrak m\cong k$; every point of $X'$ above $P$ lies in the open $U'=U\times_kk'=\operatorname{Spec}(A\otimes_kk')$. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-fibre-ring-primes-residue-fields] (1) to $\varphi:A\to B=A\otimes_kk'$ and $\mathfrak p=\mathfrak m$: the primes of $B$ above $\mathfrak m$ correspond bijectively to the primes of the fibre ring $B\otimes_A\kappa(\mathfrak m)=(A/\mathfrak m)\otimes_kk'=k\otimes_kk'=k'$, a field, which has exactly one prime $0$. Hence there is exactly one point $P'$ above $P$, namely $j^{-1}(0)=\ker(A\otimes_kk'\to k')=\mathfrak m(A\otimes_kk')$ (kernel of $A\otimes_kk'\to(A/\mathfrak m)\otimes_kk'$, as $k'$ is flat over $k$); it is a maximal ideal with residue field $k'$.

source.place: Remark 00E6 (Spec of the fibre ring is the fibre), applied to A -> A tensor_k k' at a rational maximal ideal

proof.text: The local ring at $P'$ is the localization of $A\otimes_k k'$ at the maximal ideal generated by $\mathfrak m$, canonically identified with the localization of $\mathcal O_{X,P}\otimes_k k'$ at its unique maximal ideal. Since $\mathcal O_{X,P}$ is a DVR with residue field $k$ by [lem-sc-smooth-connected-curve-local-rings] and $k'$ is algebraically closed, apply [lem-sc-dvr-field-extension-order]: the localized tensor product is a DVR, the image of a uniformizer remains a uniformizer, and the normalized exponent of every $f\in k(X)^*$ is unchanged.

source.place: Lemma 00PD, unit-times-uniformizer characterization of a DVR; tensor/localization calculation is elementary

proof.text: The fraction field of $\mathcal O_{X,P}$ is $k(X)$ by [lem-sc-smooth-connected-curve-local-rings]. Under the canonical scalar-extension map, $f$ maps to the stated pullback $f'$ in the fraction field of $\mathcal O_{X',P'}$, so the equality of exponents in the preceding step is exactly $v_{P'}(f')=v_P(f)$. This is the identification of the two displayed elements, not an additional valuation theorem.
